pull.title: test: reorder functional tests by current runtimes
pull.body:
After #36439, #36440 and #36446 some tests got much faster.

Move tests that finish faster to run later and move tests that are slow to run earlier.

Timings from master CI run [39389906008](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/39389906008):

| Test | Bucket (before → after) | CI median | CI max |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interface_http.py` | <30s (late) → <60s (first) | 53s | 60s (TSan) |
| `feature_maxuploadtarget.py` | <2m → <30s (first) | 10s | 44s (Windows native, VS) |
| `feature_torcontrol.py` | <30s (late) → <30s (early) | 17s | 20s (macOS native) |
| `wallet_conflicts.py` | <5m → <30s | 4s | 11s (TSan) |
| `p2p_node_network_limited.py --v1transport` | <5m → <30s | 6s | 18s (TSan) |
| `p2p_node_network_limited.py --v2transport` | <5m → <30s | 6s | 17s (TSan) |
| `wallet_backup.py` | <60s → <30s | 8s | 17s (TSan) |
| `wallet_address_types.py` | <60s → <30s | 7s | 20s (TSan) |
| `p2p_sendheaders.py` | <60s → <30s | 3s | 8s (TSan) |
| `feature_maxtipage.py` | <60s → <30s | 5s | 11s (TSan) |
| `feature_csv_activation.py` | <60s → <30s | 6s | 13s (TSan) |
| `feature_segwit.py --v1transport` | <60s → <30s | 4s | 12s (TSan) |
| `feature_segwit.py --v2transport` | <60s → <30s | 4s | 14s (TSan) |

Locally (`test_runner.py -j=18 --randomseed=1`) with these changes I got: 84s -> 78s (median of 3 runs)
